visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair and a red hibiscus flower behind her ear smiles brightly at the camera against a vibrant green foliage background. (2) A hand with a gold ring holds a circular red cosmetic bottle against a grey background featuring a hand-drawn yellow outline and a white 'Chanel' logo. (3) The woman sits inside a cafe by a window, holding the red bottle toward the lens; a tall glass with ice and two straws sits on the table in front of her. (4) She is seen lying on a white beach lounger wearing a red and white gingham dress and a red bandana. (5) Transitioning to a street scene, she stands before a white building with a toucan sign, holding a plastic coffee cup and posing with the red bandana and a red knit top. (6) A creative collage montage appears, overlaying multiple images of her in a Chanel scarf top spraying a mist from the red bottle in a tropical garden setting. (7) Close-up shots depict the woman in a room applying skincare drops to her cheek and using a lash serum wand near her eye. (8) She walks along a sandy beach wearing red shorts and the scarf top, holding the product and smiling. (9) The red bottle is placed directly on the sand; the woman then appears posing under a bright sun with her arms outstretched in the red gingham dress. (10) A final montage shows her running toward the camera on the beach as the frame includes a 'REC' recording overlay and digital text.
